newsitem.title: LATVIA: STOCKS EASE IN HIGHER VOLUME.
newsitem.headline: STOCKS EASE IN HIGHER VOLUME.

text.p: * Total turnover came to 107,000 lats against 76,000 lats and the Rietumu Bank bourse index slipped 0.44 percent to 171.11.
* Kaija fish cannery was the most active listing in trade of 31,500 lats and its price eased a bit to 2.30 lats from 2.31 lats.
* Unibanka stocks were also relatively active in turnover of 28,100 lats and its price dipped to 3.39 lats from 3.40 lats.
* The Riga Shipyard, which was placed on the official list this week, edged up to 1.36 lats from 1.34 lats in trade of 6,300 lats.
* Daugavpils Chain factory dominated trade on the secondary list as usual in trade of 19,000 lats and its price rose to 2.45 lats from 2.44 lats.
Latvian stocks eased in higher volume on Friday and dealers said that gains were not looming on the horizon.
"The Latvian market is still peanuts...it needs to have at least 10 new big companies before it will take off," said one senior fund manager.
The bourse itself was a bit more bullish and said that it believed the market had corrected itself and was set to rise again.
"The market has recovered from its recent fall and the correction might already be behind us," bourse president Uldis Cerps told a news conference on Friday.
"The overall demand for securities and supply in terms of money keeps growing," he added.
Total turnover for the session was 107,000 lats against 76,000 lats on Thursday and the Rietumu Bank index slipped 0.44 percent to 171.11.
Kaija fish cannery was the most active listing in trade of 31,500 lats and its price fell to 2.30 lats from 2.31 lats.
Unibanka was also relatively active in turnover of 28,100 lats and its price dipped to 3.39 lats from 3.40 lats.
Daugavpils chain factory dominated the secondary list as usual, with 19,000 lats worth of its shares changing hands and its price edged up to 2.45 lats from 2.44 lats.
